description: Check out some of the biggest players in Hip Hop...it's MTV Music's Hip Hop Heavyweights!

title: Juwanna Mann
description: Banned from the NBA, a basketball player (Miguel A. Núñez Jr.) dresses in drag in order to play in a woman's league.

title: The Jenkins Family Christmas
description: After burying their father earlier in the year, two sisters attempts to carry on his Christmas traditions without strangling each other. When an unknown half-sister arrives at the family festivities, more than just Christmas presents are exchanged.

title: Love & Murder: Atlanta Playboy
description: Lance Herndon is a womanizing local legend living life in the fast lane while trying to make his mark on the tech industry.

title: Love & Murder: Atlanta Playboy
description: Police find Lance Herndon brutally murdered in his home, leaving them to narrow down a long list of suspects.

title: Trophy Wife
description: When a philandering tech CEO is murdered, every friend becomes a suspect, including his distressed wife, who ends up in a mental institution after his death.

title: Twice Bitten
description: A wealthy widow is conned out of a large amount of money after her daughter convinces her to try online dating. They scheme to beat the con man at his own game but find themselves fighting for their lives.

title: RSVP
description: An aspiring author is forced to rely on her street smarts and martial arts skills to escape a deadly dinner party after discovering the host has vengeful motives.

title: Hello
description: An emotionally unavailable flight attendant meets a potential love interest but finds out he has ulterior motives. As the clock ticks down on New Year's Eve, she must fight to keep her murdered ex-boyfriend's secrets or find herself dead.

title: Stay Out
description: Black landowner Rufus Jones is murdered in a sundown town by two powerful men. Sixty years later, Rufus' restless spirit seeks revenge on his killers' descendants.

title: Karen
description: A racist woman makes it her personal mission to displace the new Black family that has just moved in next door to her. A community activist and his wife are the couple she's targeting -- but they won't back down without a fight.
